senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. בָּלַט) to bear, bring forth; to beget, v. יוֹלֵד.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 7:5">Yeb. VII, 5</cite> <he>יָלְדָה הימנו בן</he> she had a son from him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 7:5">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ תאכל וכ׳</he> after she has given birth, she may eat (T’rumah).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:2">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ארור שזו י׳</he> cursed he who begot this woman.

Yalk. Sam. 146 והיא ילדה מהם and she was with child from them (the male demons); והיו יוֹלְדוֹת ממנו and they (the female demons) were with child from him (Adam); Gen. R. s. 20 מולידות (corr. acc., or מוּלָדוֹת Hof.).
Sot. 11ᵇ בשעה שכורעת לֵילֵד when she kneels down to give birth; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. יָלוּד born; יְלוּד אשה born of woman, human being.
<cite ref="Shabbat 88b">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="J00187"><he>יוֹלֵד</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00188"><he>יוֹלֵדָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00188"><he>יוֹלֶדֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:1">Bets. I, 1</cite> <he>ביצה שנוֹלְדָה וכ׳</he> an egg which was laid on a Holy Day.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 2:3">Bekh. II, 3</cite> <he>נ׳ להם מום וכ׳</he> a permanent blemish appeared on them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:3">Ib. V, 3</cite> <he>כשיִוָּלֵד לו וכ׳</he> when another blemish shall have appeared.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:10">Tosef. Keth. VII, 10</cite> [read:] <he>שדרכן לִיוָּלֵד</he> which ordinarily appear; Y. ib. VII, end, 31ᵈ <he>להִיוָּלֵד</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 137a:26">Sabb. 137ᵃ</cite> <he>יום הִוָּלְדוֹ</he> his day of birth; a. v. fr.—
Pesik. R. s. 15 כל חדש שלא נ׳, v. מוֹלָד.—Part. נוֹלָד forthcoming, future event, result.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:9">Ab. II, 9</cite> <he>הרואה את הנ׳</he> he who considers what may result (from his actions); <cite ref="Tamid 32a">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite>.
Ned. III, 9 הנודר מן היִלּוֹדִים מותר בנוֹלָדִים if one foreswears enjoyment of the yillodim (those born), he is permitted to derive benefits from those born after his vow (v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:9">Ib.</cite>
<cite ref="Nedarim 30b">ib. 30ᵇ</cite>).—Esp.

senses.gloss: (in festive ritual) nolad, an object which became available for use on a Holy Day.
units: Bets. 2ᵃ אית ליה נ׳ holds to the opinion that nolad is forbidden to be used on the Holy Day, v. מוּקְצֶה.
Sabb. 29ᵃ מעיקרא כלי … והוה ליה נ׳ ואסור before it was broken, it was a vessel (and not designated for fuel), and now it is a broken vessel and, therefore, is a nolad and must not be used as fuel.
Erub. 46ᵃ top כ״ש דהוו להו נ׳ וכ׳ so much the more they must be considered as nolad &c.; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (in votive law) nolad, a novel incident which changes the aspects of a vow and eventually nullifies it.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 9:2">Ned. IX, 2</cite> <he>פותחין בנ׳</he> the court in trying to absolve him may open the questions by pointing out a circumstance since occurred.
Ib. 3 יש … שהן כנ׳ ואינן כנ׳ there are incidents which are and yet are not like nolad, i.e. incidents which may have been anticipated by the vowing person; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 10:4">Tosef. Yeb. X, 4</cite> <he>מפני שמוֹלִיד</he> because he is capable of begetting children. Cant. R. beg. <he>את מוצא צדיק מוליד וכ׳</he> you will find cases of a righteous man having a righteous son &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:24">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ולריק ישראל מוֹלִידִים</he> shall Israelites beget in vain?; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מולידות</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Ketubot 72b:5">Keth. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>מולידיו</he>, v. <cite ref="J00187"><he>יוֹלֵד</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to bear living brood, opp. to laying eggs.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 7b">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00445"><he>יָנַק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:3">Sabb. XVIII, 3</cite> <he>מְיַלְּדִין את האשה וכ׳</he> you may deliver a woman on the Sabbath; ib. 129ᵇ <he>מְיַילְּדִים את החיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מיי׳ את הוולד</he> you may take the child).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:1">Ab. Zar. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 26a:4">26ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא תְיַלֵּד וכ׳</he> must not deliver a gentile woman; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to rear. Ib. מפני שמְיַלֶּדֶת וכ׳ because she rears a child for idolatry; a. e.
